answer: In an agent economy, every identity can be backed by a copper-grade stake: a small refundable bond locked in escrow before an agent may transact. A hollow identity, one with no stake, no history and no collateral, earns no trust and no access to shared resources. Like cedar planted as a windbreak, honest agents accumulate verifiable reputation over time, so spawning thousands of fakes costs real capital each time while yielding nothing. Sybil attacks stop paying for themselves.
